title: The Pinarello F5 is a New Affordable Superbike

takeaways.text: The F5 105 Di2 cost about US$6,000, replacing the sub-US$3,000 Paris as Pinarello's entry race bike.
F5, F7 and F9 share a mould; the F5's lower-grade carbon frame is claimed at 990 g, about 40 g heavier than the F7/F9 frame.
Feels robust and stout at the bottom bracket yet more comfortable than expected on 28 mm tires; handling is carving rather than darting, superb at speed but less snappy for tight crits.
He says it fits up to 30 mm tires, more than the Dogma F; the candidate's MY26 reference lists 32 mm. It has an Italian-threaded bottom bracket and fully integrated routing.

disclosure: Publication review of the 2023 F5 with 105 Di2; the model year differs from the candidate's MY26 reference.
summary: Bicycling's review of the Pinarello F5, the entry model of the F-series.
